# JetSet Travel Cyprus

> IATA-accredited luxury and corporate travel agency in Paphos, Cyprus, since 2006. For VIP clients: VIP airport service at Larnaca and Paphos, private jet and yacht charters, luxury villas, five-star hotels and resorts, and luxury cruises.

## Services

- Corporate Travel Management: Policy-compliant bookings, clean invoicing, 24/7 disruption support, dedicated account managers
- Flight Booking: GDS fare search, direct ticket issuance via IATA accreditation, all major airlines
- Hotel Reservations: Negotiated corporate rates, worldwide hotel bookings, long-stay arrangements
- Luxury Travel Planning: Bespoke itineraries, five-star hotels and luxury resorts, luxury villas, private transfers, honeymoons
- VIP Services: VIP airport service at Larnaca and Paphos (meet-and-assist at both; Express Lane fast-track at Larnaca), private jet charter (through charter partners), yacht charter
- Visa Services: Document preparation, application guidance, Schengen/UK/US visa coordination
- Cruise Booking: All major cruise lines, including luxury lines such as Silversea, Regent Seven Seas, Seabourn and Explora Journeys, with flights from Larnaca/Paphos
- Airport Transfers: Private car, VIP meet-and-greet services

- IATA accredited with direct airline ticketing capability
